title: Flaky on Test Core: `packages/rest` `import-template-route.test.ts` › "the `*` agrees with the engine … for every shape of default the engine reads" times out at 5000ms on PRs that touch no `packages/rest` file
body:
Filed by the `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118) · `session_01DiCSbmJrkzNhuEAier4VoJ`. Bare, for triage's first grade. Whoever finds a flake fixes it or files it: this is the filing.

## Two occurrences in about two hours, on two different PRs, neither touching `packages/rest`
| where | run | PR | answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| merge-queue build | `37006699795`, **Test Core (4/6)** | #21377 (#20790) | `Test timed out in 5000ms`, the same test. The queue's triage comment `5952765227` called it the first occurrence in 24h. A single re-queue landed the PR. |
| PR-side CI | `37020507280`, job `110882211850`, **Test Core (3/6)** | #21424 (#21376) | `Test timed out in 5000ms` at `src/import-template-route.test.ts:511` |

- The test is `@objectstack/rest` `src/import-template-route.test.ts`, describe "the `*` agrees with the engine: starred exactly when the import door refuses a blank", case "for every shape of default the engine reads". It iterates every default shape against a booted engine inside vitest's default 5000ms.
- Neither PR edits `packages/rest`. `rest` depends on `metadata-protocol`, `plugin-security` and `service-analytics`, which the two PRs touch respectively, but neither change runs on that test's path. The PR-side shards on #21377's head were green, which points at load and timing.
- The test file was last changed at `88b484e00`.

## Direction (triage's to rule)
The family precedent is #20242, #20327, #20376 and #19631: a case that pays a cold engine boot, or an unbounded per-shape loop, inside the default 5000ms. Either move the boot into a `beforeAll` with its own timeout, or give the case an explicit, justified timeout. The pin stays the same assertion.

**Lane:** `packages/rest` is `domain:cli`.
